summary: 12 features, M1 → M2 → M3 in series, four each, the review last. M1 4: origin_try and outage stubs; merge_failed card, tag notes, push streaks; gc keep and harness merge without a worktree; review + docs. M2 4: DEADLINE=0 readers; HOURS default and refusal; framing and memlint run-scope; Sonnet review. M3 4: pure fix-add, rows, stubs; the round and fix session; the bound and card; review. No park.

discoveries.text: Sessions of the previous run on this repo (agent-harness-2026-11-04) took 36-55 min each at 5-9 steps; the full suite is 816 s (1224 tests), so a feature's full-suite step needs a 30 min timeout.

tests/fixtures/gh-down.txt (M1-01) is captured from a real gh against a refusing local port (GH_HOST=localhost:1 GH_REPO=localhost:1/o/r, in the scratch directory, which is no git repo): no live API is reached; never type the line from memory.
M2-01 keeps HOURS=8 as the default and tests the no-end-time path with `HOURS=` in run.env; M2-02 flips the default. Flipping first would make the driver's `now >= DEADLINE` true at once.
M2-04's review model is sonnet as the spec sizes it (the driver's REVIEW_OPUS_LINES rule escalates to opus at 400 changed lines or more anyway); M1-04 and M3-04 are opus.

header:
# Progress — run `agent-harness-2026-11-04-2` (agent-harness)

What this file is: the run's journal, newest entry first, rendered by the harness from `entries.jsonl` for Michael's phone. Each entry is one session (init, coding, verify, review, retro) with its outcome, summary and any question.

The run: spec `docs/specs/2026-11-04-run-resilience.md`, three milestones in series. **M1** merges that survive a GitHub outage: `origin_try` with bounded backoff (`ORIGIN_WAITS`), a `merge_failed` card and notification past the retries, `verified and tagged` only when origin took the tag, push-streak notes, gc keeping verified unmerged work, `harness merge` after the worktree is gone. **M2** no default end time: `HOURS` empty, every `DEADLINE` reader treating 0 as none, the night framing out of docs, prompts and templates, memlint's `run-scope`. **M3** a red verify opens a fix round (a `kind: fix` feature appended, `MAX_FIX_ROUNDS=2`), counted in `fix_round`/`fix_result` rows and a `Fix rounds` report row.

The feature list (`feature_list.json`): M1-01..04, M2-01..04, M3-01..04, each milestone's last feature its review with the decision file and the docs. A feature passes on the fast tier in its session; the verify runs the full suite (`bash tests/run.sh`, about 14 min). A milestone merges into `main` once verified. Checks are written first and watched failing; the stubs copy the lines the spec quotes from the real run, git and gh.

Steer via `INBOX.md` on branch `harness/agent-harness-2026-11-04-2`: first line `status: pause` or `status: stop`; answers under `## Answers`. Every spec default marked *default* is taken as written; the brief says never park.

summary: origin_try (lib/record.sh) retries a merge's fetch, branch/tag pushes and gh pr view/create/merge with ORIGIN_WAITS backoff; a GraphQL: or pre-receive refusal is one try. Outage stubs: tests/stub-git-down.sh, stub-gh STUB_GH_DOWN, the real GraphQL refusal line, fixtures captured. New slow file 88-origin-outage (9 checks).
verified_how: 88-origin-outage written first: 7 of 9 red on the old code (the two stub checks were written with their stubs), 9/9 after; a mutation (refusal grep disabled) turned the two refusal checks red. bash tests/run.sh 88-origin 61-needs: 20/20. Full suite (check.sh, 870 s): only 39-memlint red, from my 15th Gotchas line (cap includes the comment), removed; memlint prints nothing. check.sh --fast: green, 561 tests.

dead_ends.tried: a 15th ## Gotchas line about the origin-down stub
dead_ends.why: memlint counts the section's comment line: 14 bullets is the cap, and 39-memlint went red

dead_ends.tried: capturing real git's rejected-push line for a <sha>:refs/heads/x refspec in a scratch repo
dead_ends.why: the probe command was denied by the permission gate; not worked around

discoveries.text: STUB_ORIGIN_DOWN=<m>:<count|until <epoch>> makes <m>'s first verify session write $STUB_DIR/origin-down after its push; STUB_GIT_DOWN_ONLY=<ERE> scopes which origin calls fail (od1 uses '^fetch -q origin main$'). Put $T/down (a git symlink to stub-git-down.sh) first on PATH. stub-gh exports STUB_GIT_UP=1 so its own git never sees the outage.

M1-01 kept the old past-retries behaviour: fetch of main → log 'merged later' and return 1; pr merge past its tries still takes the merge_refused path. M1-02 replaces both; a pr merge whose response was lost would fail later tries with 'already merged': test is-ancestor of the tag on origin/main before the refused path.

A refused run calls merge_one for M1 four times (lane, reaps, finish): each is one gh pr view then one gh pr merge, so 'one gh pr merge line' in the spec reads as one per merge (88's check compares the two counts).

Review leftovers for M1-04: stub-git-down prints '<dst> -> <dst>' where real git may print the abbreviated sha for a <sha>:refs/heads/x push (unverified, no capture); git refusals like '(non-fast-forward)' or '(already exists)' are retried the full ORIGIN_WAITS; the GraphQL match was unanchored for gh pr create's wrapped 'pull request create failed: GraphQL: …' (the reviewer's recollection, not a capture, so no test fixture).

proposed_changes: M1-01 step 5's refusal run: 'one gh pr merge line' should read 'one gh pr merge per merge_one call' (a run calls it at the lane, the reaps and the finish)
